sql: SELECT y.trip_date, y.avg_trip_distance AS avg_dist, y.avg_total_amount AS avg_amount, d.d_day_name FROM whybot.yellow_daily y JOIN TPCDS_DB.date_dim d ON d.d_date = y.trip_date WHERE d.d_dow = 4 AND y.trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-11-01' AND DATE '2024-11-30' ORDER BY y.trip_date LIMIT 500
